rules.primary_error: mean absolute error of weekly admissions per day over h = 1, 2, 3
rules.D1: L2 (delay 1) significantly better than ARIMA_ADM in >= 2 of 3 counties
rules.D2: L2 (delay 1) significantly better than CASELAG in >= 2 of 3 counties
rules.A2: L2 not significantly worse than ARIMA_ADM (interval lower end <= 0) in >= 2 of 3 counties

rules.plausibility: L3 delay 1: beta at upper bound and rho at a bound in <= 10 % of origins, every county
rules.serology: model ever infected (compartments) minus survey within [-0.1, 0.2] at >= 2/3 of dates, >= 2 of 3 counties; the protocol formula 1 - exp(-cumulative infections) is reported too
rules.adequacy: L3 not significantly worse than ARIMA_ADM in >= 2 of 3 counties

rules.plausibility: L3B delay 1: beta at upper bound and rho at a bound in <= 10 % of origins, every county
rules.serology: blood donor surveys only: model ever infected (compartments) minus survey within [-0.1, 0.2] at >= 2/3 of dates, in all three counties; the formula 1 - exp(-cumulative infections) is reported too
rules.adequacy: L3B not significantly worse than ARIMA_ADM in >= 2 of 3 counties

rules.plausibility: L3T delay 1: beta at upper bound and rho at a bound in <= 10 % of origins, every county
rules.serology: blood donor surveys only: model ever infected (compartments) minus survey within [-0.1, 0.2] at >= 2/3 of dates, in all three counties; the formula 1 - exp(-cumulative infections) is reported too
rules.adequacy: L3T not significantly worse than ARIMA_ADM in >= 2 of 3 counties

rules.R1: S0 total admissions within 20 % of observed and peak week within 2 weeks
rules.R2: S0 ever infected within [-0.10, +0.20] of the blood donor survey at >= 2/3 of dates in the period
rules.primary: chain L3B delay 1; a county and period meeting R1 and R2 is reported as primary

rules.E1: Share of (origin, week) pairs where observed weekly admissions fall in [min(P0..P4), max(P0..P4)] >= 50% for weeks 1 to 4 in >= 2 of 3 counties
rules.E2: Median log(P0 / observed) by week ahead, split by growth and decline weeks, vs naive persistence
rules.E3: P0 rerun with realized doses actually given (P0_HINDSIGHT)

method: Read-only extraction and arithmetic summaries of existing saved outputs. No model code imported, no fitting, simulation, bootstrap or significance tests rerun.
